name: ali_cbct
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Anatomic Landmarks Identification on CBCT scans using AI. Detects anatomical reference points automatically. NOTE: If the user wants to orient the scan using landmarks they placed manually, use 'semi_aso_cbct' instead.

name: ali_ios
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Landmark Identification in Intraoral Scans (IOS). Detects dental and anatomical landmarks automatically on 3D surface meshes. NOTE: For manual landmark orientation, use 'semi_aso_ios'.

name: amasss_cli
description: AMASSS - Single-scan Anatomical Structures Segmentation from CBCT. Focuses on large bone structures (maxilla, mandible, cranial base). NOTE: Do NOT use this for batch processing (use 'batchdentalseg') or for splitting/isolating individual teeth (use 'clic').

name: areg_cbct
description: Automatic Registration of CBCT-to-CBCT images. Registers baseline and follow-up CBCT scans using deformable or rigid registration. NOTE: Use this exclusively for matching two CBCT scans together, NOT for MRI-to-CBCT.

name: areg_ios
description: Automatic Registration of Intraoral Scans (IOS-to-IOS) using ICP. Registers baseline and follow-up IOS surfaces (dental models/impressions) together.

name: autocrop3d
description: Automatic 3D region cropping using ROI markers. Extracts, isolates, and crops specific areas of interest from 3D volumes (CT, MRI, CBCT). NOTE: For specifically cropping the TMJ, use 'mri2cbct_tmj_crop'. For left/right asymmetry, use 'mri2cbct_lr_crop'.

name: automatrix
description: Apply geometric transformation matrices (shift, rotate, mirror, affine) to medical images and 3D surface meshes. NOTE: Use this when the user explicitly asks to apply a matrix or transform coordinates.

name: batchdentalseg
description: BATCH processing for Dental Segmentation. Automated segmentation of dental structures from MULTIPLE CBCT scans. NOTE: Use this tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks to process 'many', 'multiple', 'folder', or 'batch' scans.

name: clic
description: CLIC - Instance Segmentation for CBCT using Mask-RCNN. Fast GPU-accelerated tool specifically designed to SPLIT, ISOLATE, and identify INDIVIDUAL teeth and anatomical structures separately.

name: docshapeaxi
description: Shape Analysis and geometry classification of dental surfaces. Extracts morphometric features and evaluates tooth shape differences using 3D dental meshes.

name: flexreg
description: Flexible Patch-based Registration for dental surfaces. Registers 3D dental meshes using precise deformable patches (butterfly/curve) for tooth movement tracking.

name: medx_dashboard
description: MedX Dashboard - Visualizes data and creates interactive HTML dashboards. Use this when the user asks to 'visualize', 'make a picture of data', or 'create a dashboard'.

name: medx_summarize
description: MedX Summarize - Automatic medical text summarization. Generates concise text summaries from clinical notes, reports, PDFs, or Word documents.

name: mri2cbct_approx
description: MRI to CBCT approximation. Converts and preprocesses MRI spaces to CBCT format for multimodal registration. NOTE: Use this for approximation/conversion before the final registration.

name: mri2cbct_reg
description: MRI-to-CBCT Image Registration. Overlays, synchronizes, and registers an MRI volume onto a CBCT reference frame using intensity normalization.

name: mri2cbct_lr_crop
description: Crop volumes for left-right asymmetry analysis. Extracts left and right hemimandibular/hemimaxillary regions to see differences between the two sides.

name: mri2cbct_orient_center
description: Orient, center, and fix the position of MRI scans for standardized positioning. Reorients MRI volumes to a canonical anatomical frame.

name: mri2cbct_resample
description: Resample MRI and CBCT to uniform spacing. Harmonizes image sizes and makes them the same resolution/size for standardized processing.

name: mri2cbct_tmj_crop
description: Automatic Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) / jaw joint region cropping. Segments and extracts ONLY the TMJ or jaw bone area from scans.

name: pre_aso_cbct
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Preprocessing and orientation for CBCT. Standardizes orientation and field-of-view without user input to get the CBCT ready for use. NOTE: If the user mentions landmarks or manual points, use 'semi_aso_cbct' instead.

name: pre_aso_ios
description: FULLY AUTOMATIC Preprocessing and orientation for IOS (Intraoral scans). Straightens and orients surface meshes automatically. NOTE: If the user mentions manual landmarks, use 'semi_aso_ios' instead.

name: semi_aso_cbct
description: SEMI-AUTOMATIC Orientation for CBCT. Requires the user to MANUALLY mark/place anatomical landmarks to orient the scan. NOTE: Use this ONLY if the user explicitly mentions using, placing, or marking points/landmarks.

name: semi_aso_ios
description: SEMI-AUTOMATIC Orientation for IOS. Requires the user to MANUALLY mark/place anatomical landmarks on dental surfaces to orient the scan. NOTE: Use this ONLY if the user explicitly mentions using or marking points/landmarks.
